items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Maxine is given as the cause for other people leaving the band too. I think -- let's see, who was there before Charlie Shavers? Was it -- [INTERVIEWEE] Frankie Newton.

ctx.x: She had all these arrangements which were -- she had a goodly amount of song arrangements and they were well-made, real beautiful arrangements, and they were music. They weren't just thrown together. They weren't out and out -- you know, out and out stomp-down, drag out blues and jazz and that sort of thing. They were well arranged, and if you listen to her records you can tell in a moment.
But Maxine is given as the cause for other people leaving the band too. I think -- let's see, who was there before Charlie Shavers? Was it --
